result.instructions: Tools for CATS, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the latest candidates, one page at a time."; "Show the jobs in the recruiting pipeline."; "Summarize the activity history for candidate 123.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes CATS data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run cats_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run cats_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run cats_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. cats_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: cats_get_site
tools.title: Get CATS site
tools.description: The CATS site (account) this API key belongs to: id, mode (recruiter or employer) and subdomain. GET /site.

tools.name: cats_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the CATS users (recruiters) with id, name, title and access level. Use the ids as owner or assignee. GET /users.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: cats_list_candidates
tools.title: List candidates
tools.description: List candidates (personal data: name, emails, address, employer, skills, notes), one page at a time, max 100 per page. Use cats_search_candidates or cats_filter_candidates to find specific people. GET /candidates.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: cats_get_candidate
tools.title: Get candidate
tools.description: One candidate by id (personal data). GET /candidates/{id}.

tools.name: cats_search_candidates
tools.title: Search candidates
tools.description: Free-text search over candidates (name, email, skills, resume text...), paged. GET /candidates/search?query=.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: cats_filter_candidates
tools.title: Filter candidates
tools.description: Filter candidates by fields (read-only, although it is a POST): first_name, last_name, title, emails.primary, address.city/state/postal_code, country_code, current_employer, key_skills, notes, dates (date_created, date_modified), owner_id, is_hot... Each condition is {field, filter, value}; filters: exactly, contains, between {gte,lte}, greater_than, less_than, is_empty, geo_distance. Paged. POST /candidates/search.

field.description: A filterable field, e.g. last_name, emails.primary, date_created, status_id.

filter.description: exactly (string/int/boolean), contains (string), between ({gte,lte}), greater_than/less_than (int or date), is_empty (value true), geo_distance ({postal_code,distance,unit}); which fields allow which filters is per resource.

value.description: The value; its type depends on the filter.

match.description: How several conditions combine: all = AND (default), any = OR.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: cats_add_candidate_activity
tools.title: Add an activity (note) to a candidate
tools.description: WRITE: Requires confirm:true. log an activity (a call, meeting, note...) on a candidate's record. It only records the entry in CATS: no email/SMS-send request is made, even for type 'email' or 'text_message'. Creates a new entry each time (not idempotent). POST /candidates/{id}/activities.

confirm.description: Confirm this change to the CATS account.

type.description: Activity type; use 'other' for a plain note.

regarding_job_id.description: The job order this activity is about; omit for a general activity.

annotations.title: Add an activity to a candidate

tools.name: cats_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: WRITE: Requires confirm:true. create a task in CATS, optionally about a candidate, contact, company or job and assigned to a user. Creates a new task each time (not idempotent); CATS may notify the assignee. POST /tasks.

confirm.description: Confirm this change to the CATS account.

about_type.description: Kind of record the task is about; omit for a general task. Needs about_id.

assigned_to_id.description: CATS user id of the assignee (see cats_list_users).

tools.name: cats_change_pipeline_status
tools.title: Move a candidate to another pipeline status
tools.description: WRITE: Requires confirm:true. change the status of a pipeline (move a candidate to another stage of a job's workflow, e.g. Interviewing, Offered, Rejected). Get the pipeline id from cats_list_candidate_pipelines and the status id from cats_list_workflow_statuses. Requires confirm:true. Requests that status triggers (which can e-mail people or change records) be suppressed: every trigger attached to the target status is sent with fire=false. CATS remains responsible for enforcing its trigger semantics; independently configured webhooks may still run. The change is recorded in the pipeline's status history. POST /pipelines/{id}/status.

confirm.description: Confirm this change to the CATS account.

status_id.description: The status to move to; must belong to the pipeline's workflow.

annotations.title: Move a candidate to another pipeline status

tools.name: cats_create_candidate
tools.title: Create a candidate
tools.description: WRITE: Requires confirm:true. create one candidate record (personal data) with name, optional contact details and notes. Refuses when CATS finds a duplicate (check_duplicate=true, the default). Creates a new record each time (not idempotent); no email-send request is made to the candidate and no login is created. POST /candidates.

confirm.description: Confirm this change to the CATS account.

email.description: Primary e-mail address (stored only, never mailed).

owner_id.description: CATS user id of the record owner.

check_duplicate.description: Refuse to create when a duplicate exists (default true).
